    total = 0.0

        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))

    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap

    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    queue = headroom * headroom * headroom

    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)

        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]

        dst_node_id = -1

            dst_node_id = destination_pod.current_node

    mem_util = float(node.mem_allocated + mem_add) / mem_cap
    util = max(cpu_util, mem_util)
    if util < 0.0:

    if util > 1.0:

    return node.power_idle_w + (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * util

                        out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, target_node_id))
                        moved = moved + 1
    return out
